purpose: Prepare one bounded NPC/fauna population architecture for all regions without per-region Spawn/Destroy churn or a second world-ownership system.

ownership.LivingWorldDirector: Owns region population admission, active/inactive budgets, pool checkout/return and coarse activation windows.
ownership.ShireNPCContextSubsystem: Projects structured NPC context, memory, relationships and knowledge only for active/queried NPCs.
ownership.ShireQuestSubsystem: Owns quest/progression facts and exposes bounded read-only gates.
ownership.rule: No subsystem may independently spawn a crowd because it observed story state. Population changes are requested through LivingWorldDirector.

pool_classes.policy: Persistent identity/state; actor may be pooled only where identity-preserving restoration is proven. Never discard structured memory/relationship state with actor return.
Object pooled. Appearance/behavior seed and local state reset on checkout; no raw transcript memory.
Object pooled. Schedule/action set selected from region/world state; no full-rate global Tick.
Object pooled where practical. Activation driven by region/distance/visibility/activity budgets.
Object pooled where system design permits. Combat ownership remains with the relevant encounter system, not ambient NPC context.

update_contract: Interactive NPCs may receive high-frequency movement/animation updates required by gameplay, but context/social reasoning stays event-driven or budgeted.
Local ambient NPCs use scheduled context refresh and native UE4.27 navigation/perception only when needed.
Distant presentation uses cheaper animation/behavior and no expensive social/perception scans.
Pooled inactive actors perform no gameplay Tick and retain only structured persistent state outside the actor when required.
anti_bottleneck_rules: No per-frame loop across the entire world NPC registry from LivingWorldDirector.
No per-frame full memory/relationship reconstruction from ShireNPCContextSubsystem.
No NPC-to-NPC direct polling mesh; rumor/knowledge transfer is event-mediated and bounded to active participants.
No cloud/LLM dependency in the actor activation path.
No Spawn/Destroy bursts on chapter/world-state change; use pool warmup and bounded checkout/return.
route_transition_rule: During region transitions, destination population checkout occurs only after destination world context is committed; source-region pooled returns are staggered/bounded so streaming and population churn do not spike together.
evidence_boundary: Preparation only. No runtime NPC/fauna behavior or performance acceptance claim.
